title: Gate media encoders behind frame preservation laws
summary: Define the media-frame preservation law that GIF, MP4/WebM, deterministic image sequence, and static-step exports must satisfy before encoder integration begins.

sourceRefs.summary: Frame-sequence JSON artifact that media encoders should consume.
Existing rewind check that should inform preservation law coverage.

expectedLearning: Which frame metadata media encoders must preserve exactly and which can be sampled lossy.
How to prove media export rewind and beat alignment without implementing an encoder first.
Whether deterministic image sequence should precede GIF or MP4/WebM.
allowedWork: Define law checks and artifact metadata expectations before encoder implementation.
Keep encoders as consumers of frame-sequence artifacts.
disallowedWork: Do not implement GIF, MP4, WebM, or image-sequence encoders in this slice.
Do not let encoder APIs own semantic timing.
revisitWhen: After renderer-neutral frame adoption is stable across equation, graph, source, dashboard, and export surfaces.
